acceptanceCriteria: A write: target holding code characters outside a source-file code shape is judged as a path: an escape blocks, an unresolvable target fails closed
TS and Python source object syntax in write: lines is still skipped (BUG-0094)
A shell source that cannot be parsed, including the lone-quote sentinel of an unreadable run value, blocks with CDX-E306
diagnosis: Reproduced: judging a plan.yml holding 'write: ../../etc/x=>y' gives no finding, and a ci.yml step written as a flow mapping holding run: gives none either. Root cause 1: write-confine.ts isPathLike tests CODE_CHARS (quotes, =, <, >, |, &, $, backtick) and checkTarget and checkProposedTarget return before the escape check, on the false assumption that such a target is code; the source-file object-syntax skip already lives in isCodeShape (shell-sources.ts, BUG-0094) applied by writeLineTarget, so the filter is redundant there and fail-open elsewhere. Root cause 2: judgeFile does 'if (!parsed.ok) continue' on analyseShell, so the lone quote sentinel extractShellSources emits for an unreadable run value (T-0043) is dropped; core/dangerous-shell reports CDX-E306 for the same case. SPEC 4.7.3 states the fail-closed rule since T-0047.
